parsed.rationale_overall: Both lists are similarly personalized and address the same core issues (529, tech overconcentration, tax-advantaged retirement), but System A provides more grounded specifics (e.g., accurate I-Bond and treasury details, no fabricated tickers like VGRO/VBMFX which are non-US/wrong-fund references in B) and more concrete, executable actions. System B also includes a questionable risk_level='low' for a rebalance that maintains equity exposure and shows a negative allocation, weakening its risk alignment and actionability.
